title: Sennacherib’s Invasion

questions.question: Who invaded Judah after these deeds of faithfulness?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:1 (ESV): "After these things and these acts of faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and invaded Judah..."

questions.question: What did Hezekiah do to the water supply?
options: He stopped the water of the springs that were outside the city
questions.correctAnswer: He stopped the water of the springs that were outside the city
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:3 (ESV): "he planned with his officers... to stop the water of the springs that were outside the city..."

questions.question: How did Hezekiah encourage the people?
options: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid... for there is one greater with us than with him
questions.correctAnswer: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid... for there is one greater with us than with him
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:7 (ESV): "Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid... for there is one greater with us than with him"

questions.question: What arm did the king of Assyria rely on?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:8 (ESV): "With him is an arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God..."

questions.question: Who did Hezekiah pray with?
options: Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz
questions.correctAnswer: Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:20 (ESV): "Then Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz prayed because of this..."

questions.question: How did the LORD save Hezekiah?
options: The LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty warriors in the camp of the king of Assyria
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty warriors in the camp of the king of Assyria
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:21 (ESV): "And the LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty warriors... in the camp of the king of Assyria."

questions.question: How did Sennacherib die?
options: His sons struck him down with the sword
questions.correctAnswer: His sons struck him down with the sword
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:21 (ESV): "...And when he came into the house of his god, some of his own sons struck him down there with the sword."

questions.question: What happened when Hezekiah was sick?
options: He prayed to the LORD and he answered him and gave him a sign
questions.correctAnswer: He prayed to the LORD and he answered him and gave him a sign
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:24 (ESV): "In those days Hezekiah became sick to the point of death, and he prayed to the LORD, and he answered him and gave him a sign."

questions.question: What sin did Hezekiah commit after his recovery?
options: He did not make return according to the benefit done to him, for his heart was proud
questions.correctAnswer: He did not make return according to the benefit done to him, for his heart was proud
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:25 (ESV): "But Hezekiah did not make return according to the benefit done to him, for his heart was proud..."

questions.question: Who visited Hezekiah to inquire about the sign?
options: Envoys of the princes of Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: Envoys of the princes of Babylon
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:31 (ESV): "And so in the matter of the envoys of the princes of Babylon... to inquire about the sign..."

questions.question: What engineering feat is attributed to Hezekiah?
options: He closed the upper outlet of the waters of Gihon and directed them down to the west side of the city of David
questions.correctAnswer: He closed the upper outlet of the waters of Gihon and directed them down to the west side of the city of David
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:30 (ESV): "This same Hezekiah closed the upper outlet of the waters of Gihon and directed them down to the west side of the city of David."

questions.question: Why did God leave Hezekiah to himself regarding the envoys?
options: To test him and to know all that was in his heart
questions.correctAnswer: To test him and to know all that was in his heart
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:31 (ESV): "...God left him to himself, in order to test him and to know all that was in his heart."

questions.question: What did they cover Hezekiah with at his death?
options: They buried him in the upper part of the tombs of the sons of David, and all Judah did him honor
They threw him in a pit
questions.correctAnswer: They buried him in the upper part of the tombs of the sons of David, and all Judah did him honor
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:33 (ESV): "...and they buried him in the upper part of the tombs of the sons of David, and all Judah... did him honor..."

questions.question: Who succeeded Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:33 (ESV): "...And Manasseh his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: What was the specific message Sennacherib sent to insult God?
options: As the gods of the nations of the lands have not delivered their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver his people
questions.correctAnswer: As the gods of the nations of the lands have not delivered their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver his people
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 32:17 (ESV): "...As the gods of the nations of the lands have not delivered their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver his people from my hand."

key_verse_text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or dismayed before the king of Assyria and all the horde that is with him, for there are more with us than with him. With him is an arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God, to help us and to fight our battles.
